title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at Chandler Macleod Group (Townsville & Northern QLD, ; Contract/Temp; salary: APS4). Our Client, a leading Government Body, is looking to recruit an experienced Business Analyst on a 12 month ongoing contract. In this role, you will be responsible for: Monitor communications and engagements through the stakeholder engagement tracker and the Engagement inbox Consolidate all interactions and channels of communication including through integrating "Partners in the Community" resources Maintain and update the Stakeholder Engagement Contacts Register Prepare/extract individual or regional engagement briefs outlining previous engagement history for the region and/or the particular stakeholder, to enable and support sustained corporate relationships through periods of change; Establish and maintain individual Community/Location Market Readiness profiles covering demand and supply, models of support, travel and accommodation logistics, telephone coverage, WHS provisions for remote travel, local contacts with local councils & State & Commonwealth departments Conduct and support thematic, quantitative, qualitative and cost analysis of Qld North data ( participant, provider, costs, complaints, engagement data collections) , to inform policy positions or settings, assess risk, suggest solutions or otherwise support managerial decision making Coordinate and prepare all Stakeholder Engagement Governance reporting for National, Regional and Team forums Track and analyse issues, risks and performance; identifying areas for improvement To be successful in this role, you will have: Competency, or ability to develop competency, in consistently applying IT tools to conduct data analysis, identify support needs Competency with IT systems Experience with KPI performance reporting Advanced Excel experienceï‚· Experience with data manipulation Please note, applicants must be an Australian Citizen. If this sounds like you, please apply via the 'Apply' link.
